info.title: SURP API
info.description: Backend API for SURP, providing tenant-scoped authentication, operational health endpoints, and secure session management for transportation workflows. Protected endpoints require BOTH Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and X-Tenant-Slug headers (except /platform/* routes), and the tenant must match the token claim.

access-token.description: Access token issued by /auth/login. Use together with X-Tenant-Slug on protected endpoints.

username.description: Username or email used to authenticate.

newPassword.description: New password for the target user. Minimum 8 characters.

requirePasswordChange.description: When true, blocks normal login until user updates password via policy flow.

isBoarding.description: Whether passengers may board at this stop.

isDropoff.description: Whether passengers may get off at this stop.

scheduleStationCount.description: Station count currently stored on the day schedule.

routeStationCount.description: Station count on the line route.

addedStationNames.description: Station names on the route that the schedule is missing.

removedStationNames.description: Station names on the schedule that are no longer on the route.

reorderedStationNames.description: Station names the route moved past one another. Their existing times are kept, so after realignment the schedule may read out of sequence and needs review.

realignedScheduleCount.description: Day schedules rewritten to match their route.

estimatedTimeCount.description: Station times filled with an estimate rather than a known value. Estimates are a starting point and should be reviewed in the schedule screen.

reorderedScheduleCount.description: Schedules whose stops changed order. Their times were carried over unchanged and may now run backwards, so they need review rather than an estimate.

stopCount.description: Intermediate stop count on this direction.

missingStationNames.description: Stations the other direction has that this one is missing.

canAutoSync.description: True when one direction is simply missing stops the other has, which can be synced automatically.

conflictReason.description: Why the pair cannot be synced automatically, when it cannot.

realignedScheduleCount.description: Ride day schedules realigned as a result of the route changes.

skippedPairCount.description: Pairs left untouched because their directions genuinely disagree.

unreachableStationNames.description: Terminus stations of this line that appear nowhere on the opposite direction, so return tickets to or from them cannot be booked.

currentDepartureTime.description: Departure time stored on the reservation.

targetDepartureTime.description: Departure time of the single instance that can claim it, when there is one.

targetSeatNumber.description: Seat the reservation would take after repair. Differs from seatNumber when the original seat was sold again while this reservation was invisible; null when the target instance is full.

reason.description: Which cause of unreachability this is. "No departure that day" has several, and an agency can only act once it knows which one.

reasonLabel.description: Short Serbian name for the reason, for a table cell.

reasonAdvice.example: Tog dana voznja saobraca, ali u drugo vreme nego sto rezervacija nosi. Popravka prebacuje rezervaciju na taj polazak i zadrzava sediste kad je slobodno.
reasonAdvice.description: What the agency should do about this row, in Serbian. Usually the advice for the reason, but a row whose target departure has no free seat says so instead.

offRouteStationNames.description: Reservation stations that are no longer on the ride route, if any.

scannedReservationCount.description: Active reservations travelling inside the window.

repairableCount.description: Orphans a single instance can claim.

seatChangeCount.description: Repairable orphans whose seat number would change.

skippedCount.description: Orphans left untouched because no single instance could claim them.

summary.example: Marko Markovic, 2026-09-15, polazak 07:45 vise ne postoji.

detail.description: Check-specific fields backing the detail row in Settings.

title.example: Rezervacija se vidi na svom polasku

description.example: Rezervacija se vezuje za polazak preko vremena polaska...

scannedCount.description: How much was examined. Distinguishes a clean check from one that scanned nothing.

repairableCount.description: Violations this check could repair without guessing.

hasRepair.description: Whether this check offers a repair at all.

windowDays.description: Days ahead the time-windowed checks covered.

violatedCount.description: Invariants reporting at least one violation.

skippedCount.description: Violations the repair declined to guess at; these stay reported.

remaining.description: The check re-run after repairing, so the caller sees what is left.

departuresPerDay.description: Approximate number of departures per day.

message.example: Zelimo online rezervacije za sezonske polaske.

website.description: Honeypot anti-spam field. Must be empty for real users.

notes.example: Called twice, follow up next week.

requirePasswordChange.description: When true, admin must change password before normal login.

confirmBreakingChange.description: Confirms a change the server refused with WOULD_BREAK_RESERVATIONS, such as lowering capacity under a seat that is already sold.

invariant.description: Key of the invariant the change would violate.

highestOccupiedSeat.description: Highest seat number still sold, so the caller can see the floor.

message.example: Smanjenje kapaciteta na 30 ostavlja 8 rezervacija na sedistu koje vise ne postoji; najvise zauzeto sediste je 38.

groupId.description: Correlation id shared by reservations created together as a group

notes.description: Per-reservation note shown in driver passenger lists

travelTogether.description: When true and items.length > 1, all reservations in the batch are stamped with the same server-generated groupId so they appear as one travel group in driver exports.

activeCount.description: Active reservations booked on that ride instance.
